task.title: End of training — Good cause not shown

step.cmd: Determine the number of weeks of disqualification (between 1 and 6). If necessary, refer to Digest 1.6.9 — Course, or other employment related activity, of short duration or about to end .
In NWS, create a ROD as follows:

ul.li: Comments: Type “End of referred training — no good cause — [X] week disqualification effective [date].”

Details: Document the decision and rationale according to the Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy . Indicate the number of weeks of disqualification (between 1 and 6) and the reason. Refer to Digest 19.2.7 — Disqualification — Withdrawal from a course or an employment activity and, if necessary, Digest 1.6.9 — Course, or other employment related activity, of short duration or about to end . Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy Digest 19.2.7 — Disqualification — Withdrawal from a course or an employment activity Digest 1.6.9 — Course, or other employment related activity, of short duration or about to end

step.cmd: Verbally communicate the decision to the client.
Determine if the claim is in MPS:

ul.li: If no, go to step 5.
If yes, go to step 8.

step.cmd: In FTS, determine if there is an outstanding registration number for the referred training issue:

ul.li: If there is an outstanding registration number, go to step 6.

If there is no outstanding registration number, select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and assign one as follows:
Action: Select Assign .
Claim Source: Select 3 - Mail/Revised decision .
Service Unit: Select 1 .
Decision type: Select 3 - Revised .
Select Update .

step.cmd: Select the Disqualifications/Disentitlements (M161) transaction and input the definite disqualification as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the related registration number.
Action: Select Add .
Disqualification: Select 9 - Referral terminated .

Effective week: Select the appropriate option:
If the client was paid for the week of the end of training, select the next week to be processed.
If the client was not paid for the week of the end of training, select the week of the end of training.
Number of weeks: Select the number of disqualification weeks.
Contentious: Select 2 - Yes .
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .
Infraction: Select F - Non-fraud - Other .
Message: Select 1 - An overpayment resulted due to a disqualification .

Complete: Select the appropriate option:
C - Yes to clear the registration number
D - No to leave the registration number open for subsequent transactions
Select Update .

step.cmd: In FTS, select the Project Data - Training (M171) transaction and input the correct end date as follows:

ul.li: End date: Select the correct end date of the training.
Select Update .
Go to step 12.

step.cmd: In FTS, determine if there is a revised registration number for the referred training issue:

ul.li: If yes, go to step 9.

If no, select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and assign one as follows:
Action: Select Assign .
Claim Source: Select 3 - Mail/Revised decision .
Service Unit: Select 1 .
Decision type: Select 3 - Revised .
Select Update .

step.cmd: Select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operation Centre Memo (MM06) as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Memo (MPS): Check the box.
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Complete: Select D - No .
Select Update .

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: BPC: Select the appropriate BPC.
Work item: Select 93 - Manual Pay System .
Work type: Select 30 - New information on a manual pay claim .
Remarks line 1: Type “EIA 25 — Change to the training end date and input of disqualification is required.”
Remarks line 2: Type “T171 — END-WK-DY [XXXX].”
Remarks line 3: Type “D9 effective [END-WK-DY +1] weeks [number of disqualification weeks] 31F01.”
Remarks line 4: Enter your first name and last name.
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Complete: Select C - Yes .
Select Update .

step.cmd: Select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction to transfer the registration number to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Action: Select Change registration flag .
Registration flag: Select 4 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .
Select Update .

step.cmd: In ACS, create and send the D-01-00-00 letter. Based on the claim information, select all of the required attributes, including the following:

ul.li: Disqualifications - Definite / Indefinite - Previous / Current / Revision (2970)
D9 - Approved training course / Employment activity (2922)
We / We have re-examined your claim / In addition, we (2916)
Number of weeks disqualified (1298)
Start date of disqualification - Sunday’s date (1294)
